title: 5.5 Likes, Dislikes, and Agreement
unit_outcome: Name food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, talk about meals and prices, and order politely at a café and a market in Spanish.
goal: Say what you like with gustar and agree with A mí también / A mí tampoco.
grammar_function: Me gusta + el/la + singular; Me gustan + los/las + plural; ¿Te gusta…?
speaking_outcome: Say what you like with gustar and agree with A mí también / A mí tampoco.
